definitions.explanation: To go to see someone at their home or office. A polite way to express visiting.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}の{家|いえ}を{訪|たず}ねた。
{京都|きょうと}のお{寺|てら}を{訪|たず}ねる。
examples.notes: Can be used for visiting places

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}を{訪|たず}ねて{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to visit the teacher.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{訪|たず}ねる (visit X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing or completed action. {訪|たず}ねている = 'is visiting.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{人|ひと}を{訪|たず}ねる (visit a person)
・{場所|ばしょ}を{訪|たず}ねる (visit a place)
・{訪|たず}ねて{来|く}る (come to visit)
・{訪|たず}ねて{行|い}く (go to visit)

HOMOPHONE: Don't confuse with {尋|たず}ねる (to ask/inquire), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.
・{訪|たず}ねる (訪): to visit
・{尋|たず}ねる (尋): to ask, inquire

SYNONYMS:
・{訪問|ほうもん}する: to visit (more formal)
・{伺|うかが}う: to visit (humble)

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly formal.
